_comment: Review dispositions for the ORDER-ISSUE domain (RI-ORDERS). Same shape and same purpose as
ai_review_ledger.json / sim_review_ledger.json / tact_review_ledger.json: a row the manifest
marks `review_required` may not be promoted until an adversarial review has actually run on
it and its outcome is recorded HERE -- migration_session.py --end refuses to close otherwise.
CREATED 2026-08-28 by the O4A-C sweep, the first session in this domain to promote a
review_required row. All eight entries below come from two reimpl-verify batch runs; both
returned EQUIVALENT with zero confirmed divergences.
A CLEAN REVIEW IS NOT A TIER. It says no reader found a divergence. Every row here is also
compared against the generated golden, which is the evidence that does not share an author
with the translation -- and six rows in this domain are graded T2 precisely because that
golden cannot reach some of their arms (docs/dead-ends.md G74).
